title: Moiré weave
description: Two drifting line screens fold into an acid and violet optical weave.
useCase: Club posters, experimental sound festivals, motion identities, or an assertive editorial section.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. Dense patterns are intentionally optical. Keep motion slow and offer pause; inspect for aliasing at the final size.
look: Acid-lime and violet interference weave of fine diamond threads filling the frame, with a heavy lime sans-serif headline and monospace labels on violet blocks.
motion: Two dense sine line screens slowly drift and bend against each other in a continuous loop, so the moiré bands shift, fold and change tilt; a button pauses it.
adapt: The pattern is `FRAGMENT`: `waveA` and `waveB` (frequencies `143.0` and `139.0`) interfere, `fold` bends both and `tilt` varies the second screen's angle over `u_time`. Swap the violet and lime `vec3` colours and replace the poster copy in `.sg-moire-weave-title`; check aliasing at final size.
